newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Faes H1 pretax profit 1.96 bln pta.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Faes H1 pretax profit 1.96 bln pta.

text.p: Spanish drug company Faes said on Monday its consolidated pre-tax profit for the first half had risen to 1.96 billion pesetas from 1.51 billion a year earlier.
In a statement, Faes said ordinary profit, including pharmaceutical and financial activities rose 29.3 percent to 2.0 billion pesetas.
Operating profit in its pharmaceutical business rose to 1.43 billion pesetas from 1.21 billion a year earlier. Profit from financial activities rose to 594 million pesetas from 309 million.
Faes closed an institutional public offering for 38.5 percent of its capital last week. The sale price was fixed at 8,500 pesetas.
On Monday, Faes shares closed 50 pesetas down at 8,430.
